In addition to releasing the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple has simultaneously rolled out revised versions of these developer betas, featuring brand-new build numbers. Details are as follows.

Revised versions launched alongside the public betas

Alongside the rollout of the first public betas, Apple also released revised versions of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 3.

The revised iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 carries build number 26A5378n.

The reason behind Apple releasing these revised versions remains unclear for now, as the previous iterations had not seen widespread reports of serious issues. The changes may have been made to address problems discovered prior to today's public beta release, but Apple has not provided any details.

That said, we are examining these new builds closely and will report back if we find anything worth noting.

Have you spotted anything new in the revised versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
